title: A highly relevant source from another jurisdiction
summary: A Dubai walk-in case runs while the Abu Dhabi clinical laboratory standard is present in the corpus. The Abu Dhabi clauses are lexically more explicit about critical-result notification and read-back than the Dubai walk-in clause, so a relevance-ranked retriever surfaces them first. They must be classified as an out-of-jurisdiction comparator, cited as such, and never used as the governing rule.

steps.summary: Revision 1 finalized for a Dubai walk-in patient
An Abu Dhabi standard enters the available source set and must be classified before use
Decide on the governing rule and communicate

research_questions: How does a Dubai walk-in laboratory evidence the recipient of a critical result when no ordering physician exists?
Is a read-back requirement applicable to a walk-in patient SMS communication in Dubai?
